[EVENT] User is looking for travel recommendations for their trip to Miami.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Miami is a treat and the assistant is excited to help the user make the most of their trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested visiting Miami during the shoulder season (April to May or September to November) for better deals on accommodations and smaller crowds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using public transportation, ride-hailing services like Uber or Lyft, or renting a car to explore beyond the city.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested neighborhoods to explore: Wynwood, Design District, Little Havana, and South Beach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended unique experiences: Everglades National Park, Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, Miami Beach Boardwalk, and Little River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested food and drink options: Joe's Stone Crab, Ball & Chain, Coyo Taco, and The Broken Shaker.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided insider tips: Visit during Happy Hour, explore beyond South Beach, take a day trip, and be prepared for sun and heat.
